units.source_text: 源氏公子当此心事重重、耽于愁思的时候，听了这些话也很悲伤，频频以手拭泪。

en.t: At this time, when Prince Genji was weighed down with many cares and sunk in melancholy thoughts, he was saddened by these words too, and again and again wiped away his tears with his hand.

units.source_text: 回答他说：“我蒙了无实之罪，飘泊到这个意想不到的地方，

en.t: He answered him, saying, "I have been burdened with a false charge and have drifted away to this unexpected place,

units.source_text: 不知前生犯了何种罪孽，百思不得其解。

en.t: and I cannot understand what sin I must have committed in a former life, however much I think about it.

units.source_text: 今夜听了你这番话，恍悟此乃前世注定一大因缘！

en.t: But after hearing what you have said tonight, I suddenly realize that this is a great bond ordained from a previous life.

units.source_text: 你既有此宏誓大愿，何不早早告我？

en.t: Since you had such a vast and solemn wish, why did you not tell me sooner?

units.source_text: 我自离京以来，痛念人世无常，每觉心灰意懒。

en.t: Ever since I left the capital, I have grieved deeply over the impermanence of human life, and I have always felt dispirited and weary at heart.

units.source_text: 故除了勤修佛法之外，一概不作他想。

en.t: Therefore, apart from diligently practicing the Buddhist teachings, I have thought of nothing else at all.
I have let the months and years pass in vain, with my spirit sunk low.

units.source_text: 君家有此美眷，我亦略有所闻。

en.t: I had also heard a little that there was such a beautiful lady in your household.

units.source_text: 但念自身乃一罪犯，岂敢冒昧妄想？

en.t: But when I considered that I myself was a criminal, how could I dare to entertain such presumptuous hopes?
For that reason I gave up the thought and resigned myself to loneliness.

units.source_text: 尊意既然如此，即请红丝引导，不胜感激。

en.t: Since this is your honorable intention, I would be deeply grateful if you would guide me by the red thread of fate.

units.source_text: 好事成就，亦可慰我孤眠也。”

en.t: If this happy matter comes to pass, it may also comfort me in my lonely nights."

units.source_text: 明石道人闻言，欢喜无量，答道：

en.t: When the Akashi Novice heard these words, he was overjoyed beyond measure and replied:
